ideas.title: The Ghost Color Glitch
ideas.angle: An interactive optical illusion where viewers stare at a specific dot to see a 'ghost' color on a gray screen. This forces 100% focus and prompts comments when the effect works.
ideas.reason: Interactive illusions have the highest VVSA because they demand immediate participation. Similar 'color-filling' illusions are currently trending on TikTok and YouTube Shorts with millions of views due to the 'it actually worked' comment trigger.

ideas.title: The Triangle Gaze Trick
ideas.angle: A dark psychology tactic that uses a specific eye-movement pattern to intimidate or dominate a conversation. This triggers high retention as viewers imagine applying it to their own lives.
ideas.reason: Social power dynamics and 'dark' manipulation tactics are currently peak-interest topics. This specific 'Triangle Gaze' is a classic high-retention 'secret' that drives high shares and saves.
sources: The Definitive Book of Body Language by Allan Pease
Psychological studies on dominance and eye contact

ideas.title: The Thumb Lock Challenge
ideas.angle: A physical 'brain-body' disconnect challenge where the viewer tries to move their fingers in a specific sequence that the brain struggle to coordinate. It forces rewatches to get it right.
ideas.reason: Negative hooks ('You can't...') have a 25% higher click-through rate. Physical challenges that look easy but are hard to execute drive massive 'I did it!' vs 'I failed' comment sections.
